entry.title: New: Bill 130 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, REVENUES; CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECTS, DEPARTMENT OF FIRE AND PUBLIC SAFETY, MOLOKAI COMMUNITY PLAN AREA; AND APPENDIX C, DEPARTMENT OF FIRE AND PUBLIC SAFETY, MOLOKAI COMMUNITY PLAN AREA" The purpose of this bill is to 1) increase Carryover/Savings in the General Fund and Total Estimated Revenues by $500,000; 2) amend Capital Improvement Projects, Department of Fire and Public Safety, Molokai Community Plan Area by increasing the appropriation for Puko‘o Fire Station Renovation by $500,000; and 3) amend Appendix C to increase the appropriation for Puko'o Fire Station in the amount of $500,000 and update the project description to include planning, permitting, design, and renovations.
